$comment: Not validated against a JSON Schema -- deliberately minimal per Batch K2A instruction not to build a universal content-policy framework. This file records user-approved content rules only; it MUST NOT contain layout, typography, art-direction, canvas, or composition decisions (see designIndependence below). Design retrieval happens downstream from a ContentBrief, never from this file directly.
purpose: Objectively compare exactly two DIFFERENT Ana Seri product families using authoritative catalog/source facts.
productTruthRule: Use real catalog facts only. Do not manually re-author product specifications per post. Do not use LLM memory as product truth.

cardinality.note: Same-Ana-Seri products are NEVER Product Comparison -- they are variants and belong under Product Promotion / Same Series Variant Showcase (channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/product-promotion.json).

primary.label: differences
primary.description: The MAIN content is real differences between the two series, drawn only from authoritative catalog/source facts.
rules: do NOT turn color/finish into the core difference between product families

commonPoints.label: her ikisinde de (both have)
commonPoints.description: May explicitly show shared characteristics. Only include genuinely shared facts verified per comparison pair -- this file records the RULE, not a universal fact list (e.g. the 69 cm length / tunable diaphragm / sealing eartips example seen for Master Cardiology vs Classic III applies to that pair, not automatically to every pair).

guidance.label: orientation line
guidance.description: A short orientation line may appear after the objective comparison, derived only from verified product characteristics mapped to a use need (e.g. "If you prioritize X characteristic, Series A may be more relevant").
guidance.rule: Guidance is secondary to the objective comparison and must never assert an unsupported suitability claim unless authoritative source data explicitly supports it.

variantInformation.rule: These are secondary presentation details. The semantic comparison is SERIES vs SERIES, never variant vs variant.

designIndependence: This policy file encodes content/product-truth rules only. It does NOT and must NOT encode layout IDs, typography decisions, art-direction decisions, visual-direction approvals, composition coordinates, or design-family assignments. The pipeline is: post archetype -> product/series selection -> canonical product catalog facts -> ContentBrief -> deterministic classification -> design retrieval -> layout/typography/art-direction/composition (out of scope here).
